description_en: Modifies the disk cache size in the query acceleration configuration of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 修改集群加速配置，EIU云盘空间缓存大小
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-essd-cache-config --db-cluster-id amv-bp10yt0gva71ei7d --enable-essd-cache true --essd-cache-size 500 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyEssdCacheConfig

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID

parameters.help_en:
